items.title: Why Is PayPal (PYPL) Under German Antitrust Pressure Over Merchant Fees?
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS:PYPL) is under formal scrutiny by Germany's Bundeskartellamt over its merchant fee rules and surcharge limits. The regulator is examining PayPal's 2018 surcharge restrictions that prevent retailers from adding extra fees specifically for PayPal payments. Officials are assessing whether these conditions make PayPal transactions relatively cheaper at checkout, compared with rival payment services that allow surcharges.
